column1: # Every line is a Bash tool `command` string the PreToolUse hook must either
# deny or allow. The deny cases are the ways a raw compiler build/test reaches
# a shell; the allow cases are the near-misses that must not be swept up.

column2: env A=1 B=2 xcrun swift build
if true; then swift build; fi
for i in 1; do swift test; done
git commit -m "swap swift build for just build" && git push
